headline: This law extends federal support for the national Poison Help line, a public awareness campaign, and grants to poison control centers through 2029.
what_it_does: The law renews several federal poison control programs through fiscal year 2029. It continues the national Poison Help phone line. It also continues a national media campaign to teach the public and health care providers about the help line and other resources. And it continues a grant program that helps poison control centers provide their services.

who_it_affects.group: People who call the Poison Help line
who_it_affects.how: The national help line people call for advice about poisonings stays authorized through 2029.
They remain eligible for federal grants that support their ability to provide services.

who_it_affects.group: Doctors, nurses, and other health care providers
who_it_affects.how: They continue to be a target of a national campaign that informs them about the help line and related resources.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted September 26, 2024; programs are authorized through fiscal year 2029.
